I’m Thanuj Sai Brahma Kodapaka, pursuing my B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning at CMR College of Engineering & Technology, Hyderabad (2024–2028).

I’m drawn to AI that does something useful: understanding handwriting, finding answers in documents, or connecting a series of tasks into a working system.

Alongside NxtWave CCBP 4.0, I’m strengthening my MERN and full-stack skills and building with Codex and Astra. The goal is simple: keep learning, test ideas, and make better things.
